description: Drive to the nearest semantically tracked person and stop one standoff short of them. REQUIRES f1tenth_behavior/object_goal_bridge running with enabled:=true, and semantic_layer_node publishing /costmap/semantic_tracks. The goal_distance below is a deliberate FAIL-SAFE placeholder, not the mission: the bridge overrides /mpc/goal_pose at 20 Hz and pose mode wins, so if the bridge is NOT running the car drives 0.5 m and stops instead of driving to an arbitrary map-frame point.

moves.description: goal_distance is the placeholder; the bridge supplies the real goal on /mpc/goal_pose. goal_reached is shared by both MPC modes, so it fires on pose arrival.
